intro.title: Design Auth Flow
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple authentication flow for an Angular application, allowing users to log in and log out. You will learn how to manage user state using Angular services and handle authentication logic. The main technologies involved are Angular services for state management, TypeScript for type safety, and Angular templates for the user interface. By the end, you will understand how to structure a basic auth system to control access in your apps.
intro.usecase: Authentication flows are a foundational security pattern in nearly every modern web application, from e-commerce sites like Amazon to productivity tools like Google Workspace. As a developer, you'll implement these flows to manage user login, registration, and session handling in dashboards, admin panels, and customer portals. This lesson teaches you to design a structured, maintainable auth flow in Angular, a critical skill for building secure, professional applications that protect user data and control access to features.
